Kai Navarro: Hey team — Kai here, excited to join Product Engineering today! Quick Q: my MDM says 'pending user approval'. Who signs off and how do I get VPN access? Bonus: what's the best lunch spot near HQ for a celebratory sandwich? :wave:
IT-bot: MDM status for kai.n: pending_user_action. Action required: please open the company portal and click "Approve device" or contact IT. For VPN provisioning, submit a ticket in #help with 'vpn-request' in the message.
Leah Park: welcome Kai! :tada: Ping me or @Maya and we'll add you to the redwood-dev VPN group. If you want an immediate dev jump, use the temporary ssh key we emailed.
Maya Singh: Hey Kai — congrats and hi! I9ll approve the device in ~5 mins and start the VPN add. For lunch, try The Corner Deli two blocks over — great pastrami. Also, 30m buddy intro? I can take it today at 2pm.
Onboard Buddy: Quick checklist: 1) complete MDM approval, 2) confirm VPN access, 3) join #product for roadmap ctx, 4) book 1:1 with manager. Pro tip: bring a water bottle, the water cooler line gets long at noon. :smile:
Kai Navarro: Thanks all — I approved in the portal, onboarding flow shows completed. I'll grab the 2pm slot with Maya and try the deli tomorrow. Appreciate the fast help!
